caption: The drawing depicts a short cloak or cape with a loose, draped fit. The outer garment is dark green, and it is shown open at the front, revealing a yellow-orange inner lining. The edges of the cloak are decorated with a patterned trim that features blue and gold geometric designs, including zigzags and dots, running along the front opening, the hem, and the sleeve edges. There is an additional triangular pattern with circular elements on the lower side of the right panel (viewer’s left), bordered by the same decorative trim. The background is plain off-white, with no other objects present. A small, neatly written signature “P. Romano” is located below and to the right of the garment.
title: Bolero
